title: Python OSCORE persisted-state lacks record MAC and rollback authority (decision oscore-persist-auth; spec 15.3 R-06-215/217)
description: Decision spec/decisions.jsonl oscore-persist-auth (2026-09-03): 'Add MAC over persisted OSCORE state records in all three stacks.' Spec §15.3 requires a versioned, authenticated record + independent monotonic rollback-and-deletion authority. Status (R-06-215/217): C conforms (keyed BLAKE2b MAC domain LICHEN-OSCORE-STATE-AUTH-v1, oscore_persist.c:185-188,217-223; CAS protection ops + state_advances() -ESTALE :67-111,262-290; A/B slots; tested lichen/tests/oscore_persist). Rust gateway conforms (Schnorr48-sealed records gateway.rs:155-183; rollback floor directory :102-117). PYTHON GAP: python/src/lichen/coap/secure/sqlite_store.py schema has no record authenticator (no MAC/HMAC column), and rollback_anchor.py StateRevisionAnchor CAS is consumed by rpl/dao_persistence.py and crypto/key_persistence.py but NOT by any OSCORE store. Fix: add per-record MAC over persisted OSCORE records in sqlite_store.py (bind to context identity per oscore_settings.c analog) and adopt StateRevisionAnchor or equivalent monotonic rollback authority; tests: tamper/rollback/restore failure. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/secure/sqlite_store.py + rollback_anchor.py.
